$comment: Fixture permission set for the owner-approved T3/T4/T7 cf-verify window (TWO-669). Same groups as deploy/permissions.json: Workers Scripts Edit covers the Worker, its VerifySocket DO, VerifyWorkflow and the workers.dev URL; D1/R2 cover the ledger and offload. T7 calls the AI binding at runtime, which needs no token permission (the product deploy passed without Workers AI Read).

operatorSecrets.$comment: Set once in the cf-verify environment by the operator (step 2 of TWO-669), never in the repo. The driver pushes CF_VERIFY_BEARER with `wrangler secret put` right after deploy and sends it as a bearer on every fixture route except /health; the fixture fails closed (401) without it, so anonymous internet callers cannot spend the owner's Workers AI allowance. The manifest stored in run artifacts carries only the worker name, never the workers.dev subdomain: the driver rebuilds the full URL at runtime from the /workers/subdomain API.
operatorSecrets.CF_VERIFY_BEARER: random bearer for the campaign fixture (e.g. 32 bytes hex)

bounds.t4: 1 DO, 3 sockets, 60 min, 500 app messages, 2,000 requests, 60,000 CPU-ms
bounds.t7: 1,000 turns total (20-turn pilot included), 8,000 neurons per quota day, 4 calls and 2,048+512 tokens per turn max, concurrency 1
